name: Cherie Gabor
source:
Cherie Gabor is a bona fide movie star. Since she was discovered by German director Wolfgang Lang at the age of 18, she has made 12 movies and they have been spectacularly successful. If the term blockbuster hadn't already been coined two handful of years earlier, Cherie's movies would certainly have invoked the term. No actress had a bigger effect on the male population than Miss Gabor. Some gossip has Mr. Lang's bratwurst quite familiar with Miss Gabor, but that remains pure gossip. Cherie is quiet, confident, and private.

[Edited from in-game description]
